visual_bible.style: thick-painted Chinese 3A cinematic animation, realistic cloth motion and light scatter
visual_bible.world: spring sunset temple, wish-bell tree, stone bridge, pavilion, flowing black curtains
visual_bible.lighting: volumetric golden sun rays behind blossoms and silver-edge bounce
visual_bible.palette: warm stone, peach blossoms, scarlet ribbon, dark indigo robes
character_anchors: young woman in period Chinese dress with single red hair ribbon
bronze-skinned male in dark hanfu with sharp eyes
prop_anchors: one continuous red silk hair ribbon

title: Red ribbon reunion — ten-second compressed romantic animated film

required_story_events.description: gold dust floats at clasped hands
female claps, smiles and looks back
ribbon crosses temple bridge and pavilion
male catches red ribbon between two fingers
male turns, shows face, eyes soften
both stand against old bridge with blossoms and ending caption

shots.frame: 35mm shot through bronze bells at sunlight-lit spring wish tree, young woman centered
shots.action: she clasps both hands at chest and gazes upward; tiny gold dust rises from fingers
shots.camera: subtle dolly-in from bell foreground to close hand/face
shots.lighting: warm Tyndall-style foliage beams, drifting petals
shots.transition_out: cut on moving red ribbon as wind catches it
continuity: woman has exactly one red ribbon, same earrings and clothes

shots.frame: 85mm profile of woman against arched bridge and pavilion with one red ribbon lifting
shots.action: she claps palms lightly, smiles and glances over shoulder; red ribbon peels away in rising wind
shots.camera: upward tilt then fast ribbon-follow pan
shots.transition_out: full-frame scarlet cloth wipe reveals bridge corridor
continuity: ribbon flies to camera right with one continuous trajectory

shots.frame: tracking medium through bridge and pavilion to black gauze curtain
shots.action: single ribbon sails past carved wood posts through blossom petals into a man’s two extended fingers
shots.camera: lateral tracking speed matched to silk
shots.lighting: golden dust in slit of courtyard sunshine
shots.transition_out: cut on ribbon contact to tight palm macro

shots.frame: 85mm hand and male three-quarter face reveal by fluttering gauze
shots.action: man clenches ribbon, turns and lifts eyes; expression becomes restrained smile
shots.camera: pull back from fingers to face with subtle shallow depth
shots.lighting: warm face sidelight through dark veil
shots.transition_out: match his forward step direction across bridge
continuity: ribbon end hangs outside right fist, stable male face

shots.frame: 35mm side-tracking shot of man approaching woman, then intimate 50mm shared frame
shots.action: he reaches her, they hold an eye-contact beat, he raises ribbon toward her hair
shots.camera: tracking camera eases into stable two-shot
shots.transition_out: match hand movement into close retying gesture
continuity: male still holds same ribbon before tying

shots.frame: 50mm hair retie close-up easing into 24mm wide silhouette of bridge temple pavilion and distant mountains
shots.action: he secures same ribbon in her hair, they stand side by side among falling blossoms, dissolve to caption
shots.camera: fast gentle crane out into wide reveal
shots.lighting: sunset rim light and golden airborne dust
shots.transition_out: final dissolve to dark caption frame
continuity: red ribbon returns to woman's hair
final title set in post-production for accuracy

ending: both stand together against ancient bridge and falling blossoms; Chinese text 希望我的缘分早日降临 added in post
